Observation Evaluation Summary for obs_evaluation.py
Updated after the RMSE and variance-map layout fixes on 2026-06-26 UTC. The Google Doc has been rebuilt with native heading styles and refreshed images from the latest PDFs.
1. Run Status
Slurm job 55103820 regenerated the six layout-sensitive figures using account m4874, QOS shared_interactive, CPU constraint, and environment /pscratch/sd/y/yy6080/ocean_sim. The job completed with exit code 0 in 00:38:38.
2. Scope
- Total RMSE and spatial RMSE maps use the 2022 overlap window.
- Time-series anomaly diagnostics and OHC monthly totals use 2014-10 to 2022-12.
- Regional spectra are trimmed to Gulf Stream and Agulhas.
- SST and EKE anomalies keep 5-day cadence; OHC diagnostics are monthly.
3. Metric Definitions
Area-weighted mean: mean_A[X(t)] = sum_i A_i X_i(t) / sum_i A_i over finite ocean cells.
Scalar RMSE map: RMSE_i = sqrt(mean_t((M_i(t)-O_i(t))^2)); Total RMSE = sqrt(sum_i A_i RMSE_i^2 / sum_i A_i).
Velocity vector RMSE map: RMSE_i = sqrt(mean_t((u_M-u_O)^2 + (v_M-v_O)^2)); geostrophic velocity masks |lat| < 5 deg.
EKE: u_prime = u - mean_t(u), v_prime = v - mean_t(v), EKE = 0.5 * mean_t(u_prime^2 + v_prime^2). The EKE RMSE map is the area-weighted RMS error of the 2022 EKE maps.
OHC per unit area: OHC_A = rho * Cp * integral_z T dz. Global total OHC multiplies by cell area and sums horizontally. Layers are 0-700 m and 700-2000 m.
Residual anomaly variance: remove seasonal cycle, then remove a linear trend. For <=10-day cadence with repeated pentads, the seasonal cycle is a 5-day pentad climatology; otherwise monthly climatology is used. Variance = var(residual over time).
4. Key Metrics
Metric | Samudra 2 | OM4
Velocity vector total RMSE, 2022 (m s^-1) | 0.2127 | 0.2117
Surface EKE map total RMSE, 2022 (m^2 s^-2) | 0.02594 | 0.02504
SST total RMSE, 2022 (deg C) | 0.9768 | 0.7923
OHC per-area total RMSE, 0-700 m, 2022 (J m^-2) | 2.569e+09 | 2.608e+09
OHC per-area total RMSE, 700-2000 m, 2022 (J m^-2) | 2.262e+09 | 2.265e+09
SST residual variance map RMSE ((deg C)^2) | 0.427 | 0.3336
SST residual variance map pattern correlation | 0.6268 | 0.7027
Upper-700m OHC residual variance map RMSE ((J m^-2)^2) | 1.139e+18 | 1.314e+18
Upper-700m OHC residual variance map pattern correlation | 0.6236 | 0.6651
